About.title: A family business in Monte Pego
About.intro: We live and work in the residencial. Trust, local roots and calm living.
About.body1: MontePego Life is the estate agency rooted in the residencial — not a distant chain, but a family team that knows every street, every view and every season.
About.body2: Buying or selling here is personal. We guide international clients with clear English and local Spanish know-how, from first viewing to notary.
About.body3: Beyond sales, we run residencial services and Gastrobar La Cova — so our relationship with owners continues long after the keys are handed over.
About.teamIntro: The people you will meet at the office and around the residencial.

LaCova.title: Gastrobar La Cova
LaCova.intro: The neighbourhood table — open to residents and visitors.
LaCova.body1: La Cova is where Monte Pego gathers: coffee in the morning, a long lunch after the pool, an easy evening with neighbours.
LaCova.body2: Part of MontePego Life’s world — hospitality with the same local care as our estate agency.

MontePego.title: Living in Monte Pego
MontePego.intro: Climate, community, how to get here and daily life between sea and mountain.
MontePego.body1: Monte Pego sits inland from Denia and Oliva, between the Segària mountains and the Pego marshlands — quiet streets, open views and Mediterranean light.
MontePego.body2: Many owners are from northern Europe. They come for the climate, stay for the community, and rely on local services when they are away.
MontePego.climateA: Mild Mediterranean weather: warm summers, gentle winters, and long outdoor seasons.
MontePego.accessQ: How do I get to Monte Pego?
MontePego.accessA: Alicante and Valencia airports are the usual gateways — about an hour by car to the residencial.
MontePego.servicesA: Service centre, parcel reception, 24h security and Gastrobar La Cova, alongside the estate agency.
MontePego.secondHomeQ: Is it suitable as a second home?
MontePego.secondHomeA: Yes. Many owners enjoy longer stays in spring and autumn as well as summer.
